segments.text: sa buong buhay ng isang OFW.

segments.text: Kumilos ang one-country team ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Nagsimula tayo doon sa mga direktang naapektuhan

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: ng kaguluhan. Ang pagsaklolo sa ating mga kababayang OFW na naipit sa digmaan, mahalagang misyon ito ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Sa pangunguna ng DFA, katuwang ang DMW-OA at iba pang ahensya para sa kaligtasan, agarang suporta at ligtas na pag-uwi ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Dahil ang repatriation ay hindi lang paglapag, kailangang may hatid pa-uwi at may tulong sa susunod na hakbang.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Sa Action Fund, naihahatid ang agarang tulong sa mga OFW na nasa distress. Ang tugon ay umaayon sa pangangailangan ng bawat OFW at pamilya.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Sa OWA Emergency Repatriation Fund, may suporta, bago, habang at pagkatapos ng pag-uwi.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Sabi ko ng ating Pangulo, hindi niyo po utang na loob ito sa amin, kundi bilang panukle at parangal namin sa inyong pagod at hirap sa abroad, kaya tuloy-tuloy pa ako ang servisyo natin sa inyong pagbabalik.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Sa dagat, may panganib ding walang pinipiling ruta. Sa bawat kaso, ipinagpapatuloy ang koordinasyon hanggang sa ligtas na pagbabalik.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Kasama rin sa proteksyon ang paghahanda para sa trabaho.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: At buhay sa dagat, dahil ang pag-uwi ay iba-iba para sa bawat OFW. Para sa ilan, panahon ito para magsimulang muli.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Kaya pinagbubuklod ang mga ahensya ng pamahalaan. Ang reintegration ay hindi trabaho ng iisang tanggapan.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: May kabuhayan para sa hanap buhay, kaalaman para sa bagong kakayahan, kalinga para sa kapakanan at kaagapan para maiugnay sa mga servisyo.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: serbisyong kailangan. May puhunan, may skills, may pagkakataong makabalik sa profesyon o makapagtayo ng sariling kabuhayan. At hindi nawawala ang serbisyo sa pagitan ng mga yugto.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Naroon ito kung saan naroon ang OFW. Bago umalis, habang nasa abroad, sa oras ng krisis, sa pag-uwi, naroon ang pamahalaan upang maglingkod.

segments.speaker: President Bongbong Marcos (video)
President Bongbong Marcos (video)
segments.text: Mapapanatili natin ang katatagan ng ating bansa. At maisusulong ang isang mas maunlad na kinabukasan para sa lahat sa ilalim ng isang bagong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: A couple of minutes, Madam Chair, to highlight. In accordance, if there's a review of our NEP, our Secretary mentioned po kung gaano kaimportante ang Emergency Repatriation Fund. Ito po'y sa OWA at ang Action Fund naman po sa DMW.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa NEP po namin, alos tatlong taon po na nasa 1.2 billion po ang Emergency Repatriation Fund po ng OWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ang pumupondo sa mga tickets, international, local. Patuwang ang Action Fund. At kasama rin po dyan po yung mga airport assistance, financial assistance, medical repatriation po para sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Everything related to repatriation. Ngunit sa NEP po namin ngayong taon, nabawasan po ito ng halos 300 million.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, ito po ay nasa 900 million level, Madam Chair. Ngayon po na nasa gitna pa rin po tayo ng regional conflict at hindi lamang naman po sa gitnang silangan merong existing na nangyayaring gulo na apektado po ang ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yan ho siguro para mailapit. Ang unang-una pong gusto naming ilapit po sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dahil napaka-importante po nito. Minsan po may taon na hindi ho ito mayuutilize. Nagpapasalamat ho tayo kung hindi ho ito mayuutilize.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, walang digmaan, walang pandemya, walang masamang nangyayari.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit may taon, katulad ng taon ito, na on the part of the ERF of OWA po, we are running already on the supplemental na hiningi po namin, additional 700.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Including po yung lahat po na-utilize na, nasa 1.7 billion na po dahil sa nangyaring digmaan sa rehiyon.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At ito po ay inaasahan namin na sana po ay mabigyan po kami ng additional budget sa Emergency Repatriation Fund.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ang cost of being ready ng gobyerno sa kung ano man po pwedeng mangyari sa ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: na nabawasan po ang aming gas. Literally, we ran out of gas ang dating po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pwede ko po bang masabi rin kung bakit ito importante?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kami po ay napaalalahanan ng COA na kailangan po ay itama natin or i-update natin ang sweldo ng mga JOs po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Para po may konteksto, sa 1,600 po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: One power complement po ng OWA, 1,100 po ay JOs or over 60 percent, close to 70 percent.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Malaki pong tulong sila sa amin habang pong inaayos natin ang karagdagang plantilya positions.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, overseas plantilya positions of OWA, ibig sabihin po ang mga welfare officers namin, AS, 34 lang po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kaya humihingi po kami ng karagdagang plantilya positions.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kasi ayon po sa batas, creating the Department of Migrant Workers, katuwang po kami ng mga labor attache sa abroad.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa masamang pala do, hindi yung lahat ng post, meron pa po kaming welfare officer.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dahil po ay kinukuha na nga rin po namin sa central office at sa mga regional office, nagkakaroon po na rin ng pagkukulang ng tao.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kaya napaka-importante po ng aming mga JOs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At kung may ganun pong pag-a...

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: abiso ang COA na itaas at iayon sa current rates ang sweldo ng JO, supportado po ito ng management ng OWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At sana po, Madam Chair, mabigyan kami para naman po sulit na sulit ang kanila pong pagtatrabaho.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sila po ay halos, ang operations po namin ng DMW ay 24-7 po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At ang pangatlo po, ay noong 1995 po, under Republic Act,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: 8042, ito po ang Migrant Workers Act.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Meron ho ditong tinayo, ganun pa lang ho, siguro mga 30-31 years ago po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ang tawag po dito ay Congressional Migrant Workers Scholarship Program.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ay scholarship program para sa mga anak ng OFWs at mga OFWs mismo po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kung susumahin, halos 60,000 po per year at apat na taon po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yan po ang naibibigay na scholarship.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ay iba doon sa scholarship program ng OWA na pinupondohan ng trust fund o ibilang benepisyo.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, since 1995 po, nung nagbigay ang Kongreso po ng 50 million noon,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: hindi na po ito nabigyan ng pondo.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Gusto po sana namin din na hindi lamang po palakasin ito, lalo pong maramdaman ang ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: sa pananaw po namin, isa, if not, the major reason why our OFWs go abroad

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ay para suportahan po ang pag-aaral ng kanilang mga anak.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So with this po, may I add as well, that when it comes to scholarships po,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ang OWA po ay meron ng 20,000 scholars na mga anak ng mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At sa suporta po ng aming mahal na Secretary at ng board,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: magdadagdag pa po kami ng 10,000 na scholarship slots for this year alone.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito pong congressional scholarship, madadagdaga na naman po kung ito po'y malalagyan ng pondo at mapapalakas.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: All in all po, alam po namin na limitado ang fiscal space.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, ang aming pong hiling ay huwag naman hong kalimutan ang ating mga OFWs, lalong-lalo na po,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: sila po ay araw-araw po yan, alam po ninyo, na humihingi ng tulong, yung iba po tulong ng repatriation,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: yung iba po tulong ng livelihood.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pagdating dito, yung iba po tulong para po sa kanilang pamilya at kanilang mga anak.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Panghuli na po, katuwang po ng DMW, alam nyo naman po na under the Action Fund,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ay may kinukuha po tayong mga legal retainers abroad.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po yung mga lawyers na nagtatanggol po sa ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Gusto po sana namin na magkaroon din ng medical retainers or clinic retainers,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: dahil ayon po sa aming datos, ay dumami na po yung health concerns or medical concerns ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: And especially po, with special mention po, sa mga psychosocial counseling na kailangan ng ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: lalong-lalo na po, yung pong mga distress natin, especially po, malapit sa puso namin ang isekhans,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ang ating pong mga domestic workers.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Na talaga naman po nga, kailangan po nating tulungan at bigyang pansin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yun lang po, Madam Chair, and we're open po, at baka meron pa pong mga tanong ang miyembro po ng committee.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Thank you very much po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Thank you so much, OAA Administrator Patricia Yvonne Caunan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Before we proceed with our interpolations, I would like to recognize our other members present here with us today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: We have Vice Chair Agustina Dominique.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: And Vice Chair Maria Isabel Sagarbarria.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Now, we would like to open the floor for interpolations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: May I remind our distinguished colleagues that each member is given five minutes for questioning or interpolation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: excluding the response of the resource persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: And when you hear the bell sound, it means...

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: It means you only have 30 seconds to wind up with your questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: And as part of a long-standing and respected tradition of the House of Representatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: to accord preferential treatment to the minority members of the House

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: and followed by the independent and majority members in an alternating manner.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: So now, the Chair recognizes from the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: First, we have Representative Dada Ismula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa inyong lahat, Secretary Hans, at sa ating Administrator ng OWWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Salamat po sa pagpunta ninyo and salamat po being our resource person.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At pagpapumanhin po in advance sa aking mga katanungan, ito po'y necessary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: It has been a year since the DMW raised the minimum wage of migrant domestic workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: from 400 US dollar to 500 US dollar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano ang ginagawa po ng DMW to ensure the full implementation of this standard

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: and ano rin po ang rate of compliance by countries of destination and recruitment agencies po?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang pagtalaga po ng 500 US dollar wage for our domestic workers

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: was by virtue of the Department Order issued last August 2025, Department Order 25.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And since that time, ang sinagawa po natin ay bilang first phase ng ating implementation

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Since this will have implication on current contracts of OFWs,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ang ginawa po natin incentivization ang proseso na pinagdadaanan natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we incentivize those who on their own provided domestic workers with a 500 US dollar salary per month.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, we have 17,375 job orders processed.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: With a 500 US dollar salary for domestic workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And meron po tayong patuloy na pagpoprocess na mga job orders na ito.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ito po ay supplemented with other measures within the Department Order.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For instance, we are braced to already implement yung tinatawag na video interview, yung know your employer.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Para po maisagawa yung mismong pagpapakilala ng domestic workers sa kanyang magiging future employer.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So in this last quarter of 2026, we are braced to already fully implement itong video interview system.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Isa rin pong sinasagawa natin yung upskilling.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kailangan po kasing kasabayan ng pagpapatunay na may sapat na skillsets,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: skills being the highest form of protection ng ating domestic workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At sa ngayon po, we are undergoing projects, training ng mga domestic workers,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: turning them into other skillsets or skills options such as caregiving

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and other types of skillsets in the restaurant sector, hospitality sector.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For instance, meron tayong ilan who are in caregiving from Israel

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: na na-i-place natin sa government-to-government hiring natin as hotel workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Some of them domestic workers also from the Middle East na naging hotel workers elsewhere,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: most especially sa mga government-to-government hiring partners natin

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ngayon, the other thing we are doing is pagbibigay ng livelihood options para sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Marami po na tayong nabihayaan ng livelihood capital from the National Reintegration Center

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para hindi na sila mag-domestic work.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dito na lang po nagtayo sila ng kanika nalang negosyo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At ang dami na po nating success stories, most notably, yung nag-business plan competition tayo,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ay mga puro former domestic workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we are giving them options in terms of not just being domestic workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: There's nothing wrong with being a domestic worker.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: My own mother was a domestic worker when my dad lost his job as an OFW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero kailangan lang meron options dapat ang ating mga kababayihang workers,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: especially that they are not just caught in a recruitment trap of just being,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But the short answer to the question, ma'am, is we have 17,375 job orders processed

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: with 500 US dollars salary and counting.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Aaminin ko, medyo naantala ang implementasyon natin gawa nitong krisis sa Middle East.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nag-focus tayo sa repatriation effort at assistance measures na binibigay sa atin

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: sa nanunumbalik na OFWs na, by the way, batay din sa datos ni Admin PY,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: around 30 to 40 percent, kung maalala ko yung huling pagtingin ko sa datos,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung nanunumbalik doon sa 12,000 na napauwi natin ay karamihan domestic workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So it is still a work in progress, Madam Chair, Congresswoman Dada,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and rest assured we will continue to implement the 500 US dollar salary

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: until it achieves a level of acceptability across the board

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and then we can mandatorily impose the same.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Definitely understandable dahil sa naging conflict nga naman sa Middle East.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So nagagalak ako na marinig na it is still ongoing up to the present na madagdagan pa

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at sana ay across the board na talaga na mataasan or ma-increase ang kanilang salary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: lalong-lalo na yung mga domestic workers po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dadako naman po ako, Madam Chair, sa on-action.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang agarang kalinga at saklolo para sa mga OFWs na nangangailangan o action fund

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ay itinatag para mabigay ng timely and responsive services sa mga OFWs at kanilang mga pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Lalo na kapag sila ay nasa distress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pero meron pong ilang reports mula sa ground na mabagal ang disbursement ng financial support under action fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madalas daw po ay umaabot ito ng 3 to 6 months

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May mga kaso pa ng OFWs na namatay sa chronic illness habang naghihintay pa rin ng agarang kalinga at saklolo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano na po ang ginagawa para mabawasan ang red tape

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at mapabilis ang disbursement at case management system ng DMW para sa action fund at sa iba pa nitong programa po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Chair, with the permission, I will make an initial comment.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But Yusek Feli Bay can also supplement the answer.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But at the outset, let me say na 80,000, as I reported, 80,000 na po ang nabigyan ng financial assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, tama po kayo, meron talagang hindi pa nabibigyan at meron na rin matagal-tagal nag-antay.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But the cause of this is once again, we don't use this as a common excuse

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and I don't want to always get back to the crisis.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But ang nangyari po, yung 2 billion action fund natin na ubos po

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: because of our massive repatriation and financial assistance distribution effort nung krisis.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nung krisis, the height of it in March, April, May, yung US-Israel-Iran war,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ay 20,000 po ang nabigyan natin ng action fund assistance on the ground.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero malamang po kung dadaang you're referring to those who are here,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So sa ngayon, naubos yung 2 billion, but as Yusef Niki mentioned,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: no less than the President himself on June 23rd announced a 3 billion peso.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Hinigitan pa ni Pangulo yung 2026, yung 2025 budget.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: If it was 2 billion in 2025 as set in the 2026 GAA,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: sabi ni Pangulo, ang supplemental nyo, 3 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So ongoing po ang distribution, rest assured.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Siyempre, mayroon lang usual COA procedures before we release,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: I wish we could just immediately unload the 3 billion that quickly,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: but rest assured, the releases are ongoing.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We post this naman po, at least some of the releases on our Facebook page

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: just to make our people know that the releases are ongoing.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And rest assured po, makukompleto natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: The 3 billion peso allocation of the President himself is definitely enough

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to cover all the pending claims.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And rest assured, we will cover all the claims by the early 4th quarter, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Chair and Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At least po, ito'y maibibigay pa rin sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And naintindihan po natin na because of the crisis din,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: at medyo late nga po yung mga downloads of funds.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nga raw po ng mga iba-ibang departamento.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, most likely, baka isa din po yun sa tinitignan na dahilan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, kaugnay nga po ng Action Fund,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: maari ko bang matanong ang ating ginoong sekretary na

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: magkukumit ba po ang DMW na amyendahan ang Department Order 02-2025

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: o omnibus guidelines on the implementation of the Action Fund

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para malinaw na ma-define ang ideal disbursement rate po.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, right now, ang disbursement rates natin,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: generally speaking, are 50,000 for the distressed cases,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and 100,000 kapag nasawi ang ating OFW sa kanasamaang palad.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But yes, we are reviewing these rates kasi,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: meron din tayong quick action na tinatawag po eh.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, by way of example, pag may dumating na OFW,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: at ang case niya is not as major as the others,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: pero kailangan niya ng pamasahe, pauwi,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: kailangan niya ng pantawid kahit papano,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: may matutustos siya sa, halimbawa, bilang pocket money niya pauwi ng probinsya,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: then we have that quick action.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, we have a window where we provide 10,000 to around 5,000 to 10,000 to 30,000,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, but you're right, Mama, we need to rationalize and make sure that there is a definite schedule

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para malinaw po sa taong bayan kung ano yung saan na pupunta,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: saan na lalagay yung kanilang sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But there is another special rate which is around 30,000 pesos for the,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ito po yung mga either hindi nakaalis, illegal recruitment victims,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: or sila po ina-uwi, halimbawa, dun sa scam hub sa Southeast Asia.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, we have pegged the amount for them at 30,000 pesos.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, meron pong ganong klaseng differentiation lang tayo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And you're right, we are reviewing the same, Madam Congresswoman,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and we'll issue the amendatory guidelines soon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Salamat po, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dada ko naman po ako sa repatriation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Base sa naging karanasan natin sa emergency repatriations dahil sa US-Iran conflict,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ano po kaya ang assessment ng DMW patungkol po dito?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, ang assessment po natin, unang-una, may kahandaan po tayo at the outset

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Unang-una niyang sinabi, day zero, kumbaga, Feb 28 kasi pumutok yung sigalot.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: May clear instructions na si Pangulo sa amin ni Sec. Tes. Lazaro ng DFA

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to provide the welfare services for our OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At kami ni Admin PY, ang unang-unang naming naisip nung lumabas itong pumutok itong sigalot

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: is yung mga masastranded gawa nung nasara yung airspace sa Gulf States, Dubai, Qatar, etc.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So kami ni Admin PY, nagtungo kagad kami sa airport.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dahil alam namin magkakaroon ng embudo dun sa airport.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dahil na-cancel ang flights, hindi na tuloy, and therefore may mga nasa labas ng airport

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So binigyan na ho namin ng agarang tulong and Admin PY could provide.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: May data rin ho sila dyan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So that's one, the mechanisms, the systems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: On that particular day also, we met virtually all the ambassadors.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sec. Tes. Lazaro and all the ambassadors on the ground with the labor attachés.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nagpulong na po kami lahat and activated our crisis manuals, crisis management systems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Existing na po ito. Marami nagtatanong kung meron bang ganito.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron na po talaga, nakaabang na ito. So it's all a matter of activating these systems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then, one key learning also is not all conflicts have the same size, so to speak.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ibig sabihin na hindi one size fits all ang conflict.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And this particular conflict is most, is kumbaga the best example of this principle.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi never pa ho nangyari na pitong bansa ang involved.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Usually, when it's Israel-Lebanon, dalawang bansa lang po yan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But ito, covering yung theater of military operations, covered seven countries.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And so that was the challenge.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And we learned now, now, it's in our rule book, it's in our manuals, what to do kapag ganong karaming bansa

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ang literally involved sa drone attacks, missile attacks, dahil nandun nga rin po ang kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So there was a learning experience, but at the same time, we needed to learn fast and apply our systems fast.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So ang resulta nga po ay 12,000 ang nakauwi.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: 12,000 na hindi nakauwi, pero nabigyan ng financial assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And the other learning is resources.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So I'll go back to my point, ang point namin ni Admin PY.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Talagang we need to have already, hindi, masasabi ko talagang hindi, I think Admin PY mentioned this already,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: hindi po pwede talagang eksakto ang bit-bit namin sa bulsa namin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At the beginning of the year or at any given time, because anything can happen, as we all know.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Unfortunately, the geopolitical situation is unpredictable.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And so we must have the necessary resources, because we can and do mobilize such resources,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and not just financial, I'm talking of material and human resource, when the time comes.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Handa naman po tayo, but we just really need the proper resources in our hands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I agree with that, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At follow-up na lang po dyan, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sa tingin niyo po ba may mga kailangang baguhin sa allocation, sa guidelines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: o kaya sa mga case management patungkol po sa pagiging mas responsive natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at para mas maging sufficient din po ang pondo sa mga ganitong biglaang sitwasyon po?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: more than anything, yung financial resources, capabilities namin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Of course, yung human resources, dapat nakaabang, but that too is a function of our systems,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: yung hiring processes and systems namin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It's a good thing that before this conflict started, na-approve ng DBM on our part,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: yung labing-labang additional items dun sa fund administration, action fund administration side.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So nagpapasalamat kami kay Presidente sa DBM kasi nagkaroon ng fund management system yung aming action fund

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: before this all happened. So that was in place.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And there were people who were dati kasi parang ad hoc task force lang,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: but now there are really people and systems governing the action fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Parang mini OWA, if I may say so, within the DMW that governs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kung trust fund ng OWA, kami naman governing the action fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But again, I hate to be repetitive.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But really, it's a matter of having the right resources.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi wala nang tatalo pa sa saying yes at the right moment.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kesa sa ang sagot namin sa tao, ay pasensya na, wala kaming pondo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And we always need to be ready in terms of our financial systems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Now let me also add, na kami naman po are also in the process of enhancing our ISO systems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So on the part of the DMW and the OWA, we are geared to sharpen our ISO systems

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para mabilis ang disbursement ng pondo, selection of our human resources,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: mobilization of our human resources when the time comes.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So right now, we're beefing up our human resources at the posts.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang aming mga posts, for instance, we recently opened our 43rd office in Cambodia.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So ngayon, may tao na tayo nakaposition doon together working with our DFA

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to respond to distress calls from our OFWs who are victimized by the scam hubs

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: or employed, unfortunately, by the scam hubs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So this is another learning that we've had.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It's always good to preposition our people.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And that will probably be my final point.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pagdating ng emergency, etong huling sigalot,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: admin PY and I were able to preposition our people sa fly-out points.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Not necessarily doon sa seven countries.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Para nakaabang nasa border, sundo, fly out.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So ganon kahalaga rin yung resource, human and financial.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Because dapat makabili kami kagad ng ticket, makabuo kami kagad ng augmentation teams

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sa countries kung saan sasalubungin na yung lumalabas ng mga kababayan natin sa border.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And I'm pretty sure, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary, na kapag bumibili kayo ng ticket on the spot,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: napakamahal po ng mga ticket na ito.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes. At hindi naman ho namin pwede sabihin sa inyo,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: pasensya ho, hindi kami nakabili ng ticket kasi mahal.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Siguro pagagalitan nyo kami pag yan ang explanation naming sasabihin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Hindi kami umabot ng 12,000 kasi mahal ang ticket.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero the good news is, umabot kami ng 12,000 kasi we just basically brought people home.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: That was the main goal under the directive of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And we note, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: present po si Secretary Kakdak noong nagkaroon kami ng konsultasyon sa ating mga ilang mga OFW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nagpapasalamat kami doon kay Secretary Hans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kailangan po namin na put into record na hindi lahat ng mga kababayan natin po abroad,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: which is na-mention naman po ni Secretary Hans kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May mga ilang mga OFW po na nagre-request lang ng support for shelter

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: and other protective programs during the conflict.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: We also agree with the OAPY statement earlier,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: and that's why this representation would like to manifest that we support,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: an increased budget for the Department of Migrant Workers and OWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ngayon pa na may global conflict sa Middle East, ngayon pa talaga kayo binawasan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kung saan maraming mga OFW, dapat mas palakasin at palawakin pa natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang mga programang mag-aalaga sa ating mga kababayan abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Lalo pa sila po ang isa sa mga nangungunang nagpapatakbo sa ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po to the DMW family.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So nagbigay tayo ng financial assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And with admin PY, yung grocery food pack.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So hindi lang financial, kundi basic food and shelter, and then—

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Temporary accommodation, tama, shelters that we provide.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi nga po, ayaw nila umuwi.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero gusto muni nilang manirahan sa isang lugar kung saan they feel safe.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And minsan pa, pinupuntahan pa na.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At tapos kung may host country designated shelter, katulad ng Bahrain at Israel,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pinupuntahan namin sila doon sa government, host country government designated shelter

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So hindi ibig sabihin may host country government designated shelter,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pinupuntahan pa ho namin sila doon at binibigyan pa ng basic needs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, with your permission, just to add.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Gusto ko lang pong klaruhin na yung aming emergency at repatriation assistance ng DMW at ng OWA,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: hindi lang po kami taga-bili ng ticket, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung ating pong rapid response team, yung minensyon po ni Secretary.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung rapid response team, yung minensyon po ni sekretary.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: March 2 pa lang po nakapuesto na po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngayon po siguro pwede nang sabihin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa border ng Egypt, sa Oman, sa Bahrain po, sa Kuwait, sa Qatar, sa Saudi, sa UAE,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: nagpadala po tayo ng mga tao po dito at literal po,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: tinutulungan pong makatawid from one border to the next.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung ating pong mga flights out of Oman, meron po doon kasama ang mga kababayan natin from UAE.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Out of Riyadh, mga kababayan po natin from Kuwait, itinawid po natin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Bahrain, Qatar, at syempre sa eastern region rin po ng Saudi.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito pong rapid response team po natin, of course, adopting a one country,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Doon na po makikita yung iba't ibang assistance.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dito po napupunta yung pondo po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung pong sa hotel nila, yung pong sa transportation, sa meals po nila,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: hanggang po sa air tickets papuntang Maynila,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: hanggang pong ticket po nila pauwing probinsya ay tinutulungan din po natin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: And on top of it, of course, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ang financial assistance po na ibinibigay po natin ng DMW at saka ng OWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Napaka-importante po nitong RRT, yung sinasabi po ni SEC na personnel,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: dahil po, kailangan pong i-augment yung ating pong mga teams abroad pag meron pong emergency.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So siguro, yung po rin ang maidagdag po, matingnan natin kung paano po mas mapalakas

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: yung ating pong personnel abroad kasi po ay sila po ang talagang nag-aaral.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Frontliners po, frontliners, lalong-lalo na po pag may emergency.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sila rin po naka-experience nung mga, kami po ni SEC, nung pumunta po kami ng Romania recently SEC,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: dahil po doon sa naging conflict din po that were faced by RC Ferrer sa Black Sea,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: nakakatanggap din po kami nung emergency warning for drone attacks.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ganyan po ka-totoo ang emergency warning.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ang nangyayari at yan po ay regular na na-experience.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Hindi lang po ng ating mga OFWs, pati po ang ating mga deployed personnel po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Now, from the majority, the Chair now recognizes Representative Mica Gonzales.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you, Sec. Hans, for coming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: And also the OWWA family and the DMW family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: I just have a few questions on the reintegration program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Because from the previous hearing sa People's Center, I asked whether the people who asked for a repatriation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: do they have a chance to go back again to work?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi siyempre, kaya nga sila nag-abroad kasi gusto nila magtrabaho abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: But given the situation, they cannot continue working there because of the conflict.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So I would like to ask on the update on the reintegration program doon po sa umuwi from Middle East to the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And yes, this is a foremost directive and concern also of no less than the President.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So ang sinagawa po natin, unang-unang step po doon is the profiling of those who had returned.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we need to know who they are, what their skill sets are.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And whether or not they have an intent to return.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: A vast majority, based on the profile tools, yung digital profiling na ginawa ng OWWA at ng DMW, want to stay.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So dito po sa vast majority who want to stay, of the 12,000 po, roughly mga 9,000 were OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: 3,000 of the 12,000 were dependents of OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Mga anak po, kasi OFWs naman usually will bring their children or dependents and they will not go home without their children and dependents.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So of the 9,000, nagkaroon po tayo ng intervention sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We knew who they were coming in.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And nag-conduct po tayo ng around nearly 20 National Reintegration Network Job, Livelihood, and Skills Fairs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And dito po, una, aside from the job offers na binigay, nagkaroon din tayo ng active labor market interventions.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, based on their profiles, nalaman natin ang skill sets nila at hinanapan natin ng corresponding job orders overseas.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Overseas po ito, wala pa dito yung DOLE side, yung local.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So based on this framework, we had sent letters.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Emails to the returning OFWs and told them, okay, you are a barista in UAE.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ito ang mga job orders natin sa Asia and Europe and Americas pertaining to the job of being a barista.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we had sent them emails and the ongoing process po ito, admittedly, hindi instant ang acceptance nila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But meron na po mga napaprocess for possible work overseas.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For those who wish to establish businesses, ang livelihood interventions naman po natin are through, of course, the DMW and OWWA reintegration funds,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: but also DTI, Department of Trade and Industry, a Small Business Corporation, have their own loan facility, especially for returning women workers through Sec. Cris Roque.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sec Kiko Laurel also has his own Department of Agriculture, Agribusiness Interventions, Startup Capital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sec. Dita of DOT, meron ding mga tourism-related businesses offered, among others.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: DOST meron din, science and technology related.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Now, sa skills enhancement, nandun din si Sec Kiko Benitez, DG Kiko Benitez at ang TESDA.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, sa mga national reintegration fairs po namin, nandun yung mga agencies na binanggit ko.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Tapos, nandun yung TESDA to offer skills-related certificates, training vouchers for the returnees.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Tapos, meron pa ho itong 160 pesos stipend. Libre yung training, tapos may stipend pa yan daily pag natanggap sila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: By way of example, galing kami sa Naga.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At doon, merong mga 25 na binigyan ng certificate to start their six-month AI course, AI-related course with STI.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So that’s just an example of doon naman sa skills-related part.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Now, there would be around 30–40% in the category that you mentioned, Madam Congresswoman.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ito naman po, meron na po rin pong nakabalik.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi it takes six months from the time they leave UAE, for instance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Buhay pa for six months yung kanilang valid employment visa.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And they can just easily return to re-assume their jobs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Some were employed in businesses na talagang tumigil.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, they are waiting for their businesses to resume.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But some were able to already come back, to go back to the work that they have.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For instance, mga hotel workers at mga office workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron naman po sila rin nabalikan ng mga trabaho.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So, from what I understood, kapag po yung isang OFW yun na repatriate from the UAE back to the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Whether they go back abroad, it may be Asia, it may be the Middle East or Europe,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: The second question is about OFW Hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Because I represent po kasi third district of Pampanga and I cover San Fernando City, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So, I would like to ask because the last time I visited there,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: there was a problem on the procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Yung mga pasyente, siyempre they cannot wait.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So, ang daming reklamang dumadaan that time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So, I would like to ask from your office, Sec. Hans, or anyone from DMW,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: ano na po ang status ng procurement process?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: And number two, how’s the plantilla positions in OFW Hospital?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron tayong, on average, ongoing po yung procurement po at least on two major items.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: One is yung sa medical supplies and one is on yung, should I say, the hard equipment,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: yung mga medical machines such as CAT scans.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, doon po sa medical supplies, we had substantially resolved the problem.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: There used to be pagkukulang-kakulangan ng mga gamot sa pharmacy.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But because we had partnered with a Philpharma group,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sina Usec. Kim, which is an adjunct,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: of the DTI, yung pharma tie-up ng DTI,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ay na-resolve na po ito kasi nagkaroon na ng steady delivery of medical supplies.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So the challenge is mainly doon sa equipment.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And one key development here is it took quite a while,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But finally may sarili nang BAC, Bids and Awards Committee, ang ospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For a while, it was centralized with the DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But the problem there kasi is we needed to wait for the right moment

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: na na-position na yung mga regular employees that had been filled up.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And the number we have is around 198, regular positions that we had filled up.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Hinintay po muna namin sila mag-settle down upon hiring

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para sila magkaroon na ng kumpiyansa at sistema sa kanilang procurement.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, we had turned over procurement duties to the hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And this will go a long way.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: kasi mas, kumbaga obviously, mas autonomous sila at mas mabilis na silang umaksyon

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: yung 41.4% and the rest are still in the preliminary process.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: hindi po... kasi iba-iba naman ang timelines.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Still under process by the BAC.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But at release, 77% of our procurement items had been acted upon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And the rest still under-processed yung paperwork sa BAC.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: You may be referring to the recent problem we had with our CAT scan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But this had already been resolved.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We even sought the intervention of the Japanese authorities.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi galing sa Japan yung makina, yung equipment.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, this had been recently resolved.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And the key equipment part is now braced for delivery.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we are now braced to testing na

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and then we will now operate the CAT scan machine once again.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then, merong MRI machine that is up for procurement.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: With your permission, can I ask you, Sec. Nikki, so I don’t keep looking at her, to respond

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to the MRI and other concerns.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: With the permission of the Secretary, po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Yung mga equipment po, critical equipment, have already been delivered.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And under procurement po ngayon yung mga gagamitin din po ng ating cancer care facility

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: which hopefully by first quarter or second quarter of 2027 ma-operationalize na rin po natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And on top of the plantilla positions mentioned earlier by the Secretary, we were given

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: 308 permanent plantilla positions under level 2 accreditation from the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And we continuously hire medical and administrative staff at the moment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you for those answers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi po, I'm very into the OFW Hospital because I filed a bill

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: at approved na po ito sa Committee on Health to make it level 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Kaya I'm very much concerned about OFW Hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: But on that note, of course, I fully support the manifestation of Kong Dadah to increase our budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi yung mga nandito nga sa Pinas, atat tayong tulungan, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: What more yung mga nasa abroad na malayo sa pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So I think that's a point na kailangan nating make sure na they are catered for, they cared for,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: and most importantly, dapat naramdaman nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So that's all, Madam Chair. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Now, from the minority, the Chair recognizes Honorable Robert Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And good afternoon to the DMW family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, I refer to the August 25, 2026 letter of...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: OWWA Administrator, Attorney Patricia Yvonne Caunan, requesting our support

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: for an additional 2 billion in OWWA's fiscal year 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, I am disappointed with the NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: OWWA's total budget appears to increase by 1.48% because personnel services increased.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But MOOE was cut by 64.812 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And the Emergency Repatriation Fund by 308.778 million, or 24%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Now, my question is, Madam Chair, through the Chair, may I ask Administrator Caunan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: OWWA proposed 12.8 billion, but only 4.3 billion was included in the NEP, despite the 8.533 billion gap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: OWWA is asking Congress to restore only 2 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Is this already the irreducible minimum for statutory life and safety and implementation-ready requirements?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, with the permission of our Secretary,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At alam niyo po, siyempre po para sa OFWs, dapat itodo, Madam Chair, Cong.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung nasabi na po ni Sec. Hans, ito pong krisis paiba-iba.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa Middle East crisis, pitong bansa, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At hindi lamang naman yun ang krisis na dinadaanan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Marami din po tayong tinutulungan na medical repatriation at iba't ibang klase pong emergencies as defined.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Alam niyo po, Madam Chair, nasabi ko kanina,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At ngayong nasa gitna po tayo ng matinding, hindi pa ho tapos ang krisis ng US-Iran conflict.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung 900 million ho, Madam Chair, hindi sapat.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ang hinihingi po namin, of course, at the very minimum po, i-restore yung 1.2.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, siguro naman ho bilang administrator,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: mandato ko rin ho talagang i-advocate.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Currently po ang nagastos na po natin ay 1.7 billion.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ibig sabihin ang amount na 1.2 or on the part of DMW na 2 billion.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pag may krisis na kasing laki ng hinarap po natin, Kong at Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: tatlong buwan, anim na buwan, ubos na po agad.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pag po krisis, ang ticket po walang promo fare.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ang ticket po nakatodo po, lalong-lalo na kung limitado ang tickets

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: at ang mga aeroplano, hindi po sila lumilipad.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, when we asked Madam Chair for additional budget of 2 billion,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: of which close to 600 million is for the emergency repatriation,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: we were just looking at what currently,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: But aside from the Middle East crisis, there are other geopolitical conflicts

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: in other parts of the world, Madam Chair, even near us here in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: that kailangan din po maging ready yung ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, nung nag-propose po ang OWWA ng 12 billion po sa DBM,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Limang billion po doon sa 12 ay para po sa emergency repatriation fund.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, syempre po, naiintindihan natin the limited fiscal space,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: naiintindihan po natin lahat, kailangan ng additional budget, kailangan ng tulong.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, sa gitna ng pinagdadaanan natin ngayon, na hindi pa tapos na krisis, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ay hindi naman yata namin kakayanin na mas mababa pa po ang budget kesa noon na walang ganitong klaseng kaguluhan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, magkano po yung nagastos nyo before the crisis?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And how much did you spend after the crisis?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Maganda pong tanong yan, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Normally po, for the last, I would say 2024 and 2025, out of the 1.2 billion,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: so ibig sabihin po, walang aggravation ng regional conflict,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Our utilization for the ERF was already

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngayon po, noon nagkaroon ng krisis, naubos po yung 1.2,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: in fact, humingi po kami ng supplemental na 700.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, normally po, kung walang ganitong klaseng intensification of conflict,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: we're already utilizing 60% of the 1.2 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And this was spent on what, particularly?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
Rep. Roberto Nazal
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Before the crisis, still the same repatriation expenses,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: meaning international airfare, hotel or temporary accommodation,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: medical escorts if needed, medical repatriation, land transportation,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: domestic flight tickets, hotel accommodation here in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
