segments.text: financial assistance for the repatriated workers,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Karamihan po ng, Madam Chair, ng mga kaso prior to the crisis,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ano po yung kaso ng mga ni-repatriate natin?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Malaking porsyento po dito ang mga nawawalan po ng trabaho na ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit ako na po ang unang aamin,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: tumaas po ang medical repatriation din po natin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ang mga kababayan natin na hindi po natin puwedeng iwan abroad,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So alam nyo naman po, pag medical repatriation, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: nire-require po minsan ng ospital or doktor na kailangan po may medical escort,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ibig sabihin po nurse kasama sa aeroplano,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: at minsan po pag, depende po sa attending physician,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: sasabihin po nila baka kailangan nung ating worker ay tatlong upuan dahil hihiga po siya,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: kung anong kailangan para maiuwi yung ating kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: so this is also being paid by the emergency repatriation fund po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ano pong sinabi ng DBM bakit nire-reduce nila yung inyong repatriation fund and yung NEP?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, if I may po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: I believe that they're looking at utilization rate and the utilization rate of 2025.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: and this is, I would say, outside the control of the Department of Migrant Workers or OWWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: The repatriation, emergency repatriation fund at ang action fund, ito po ay mga standby fund na pag at kung saka sakaling may,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I ask the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: does DMW fully endorse the entire 2 billion request and commit to defend it through final congressional action?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We stand by all our requests between the OWWA and the DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We are joined at the hip.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya po kami ay magkatuwang at

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, the short answer is yes, we endorse this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, I strongly object to using utilization rate mechanically as a reason to reduce the Emergency Repatriation Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We cannot predict when war, mass displacement, or evacuation will occur, but we can anticipate and prepare.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: A contingency fund does not become unnecessary simply because the worst crisis did not occur during a particular year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: In any event, utilization is already high, as mentioned by Administrator Caunan's letter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sinabi po niya na 81.92% of the current fiscal year 2026 ERF appropriation has already been utilized as of July 31.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The separate OWWA table submitted to us as of August 25 shows total ERF expenses at 1.6 billion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I ask the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: was the 24% reduction in ERF based wholly or partly on past utilization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If so, does the DMW agree that this is an unsafe basis for determining the required level of a life and safety contingency fund?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: The numerics po, I think PY can perhaps respond to the details.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But I can fully subscribe to the principle that utilization is a difficult basis.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And having said that, utilization anyway will be dependent on the geopolitical situation.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And as the February 28 US-Israel-Iran war had clearly proven,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: any geopolitical crisis can happen anytime.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: beyond our control in terms of the powers that be,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But, however, it is definitely within our control

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to have the necessary resources ready to be mobilized when the time comes.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And the President has clearly given us clear instructions

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ito pong pagbigay sa amin ng Pangulo

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ng 3 billion peso supplemental fund is a very, very clear statement

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: the President himself na napakahalaga ng resources.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya for our part, Mr. Congressman, if I may speak also for the DMW,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ang gusto rin naman na hoon naming level sa action fund namin

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: is 3 billion as set by the President himself.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi 2 billion lang hoon kami sa NEP.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then there are items din po to round up the 2 billion figure from the DMW side

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: that had already also been justified in our letter to the Speaker.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: When it comes to crisis responses,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: precisely, there is no crystal ball that will tell us when a crisis will occur.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And so, we must be sure that there are resources always ready 100% of the time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Natigil na po ba yung Middle East conflict?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: I believe the political expert to conclude on this matter,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, we can say for ourselves that while there is a ceasefire,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: there was a ceasefire, and it appears to be implemented at the present,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: we can be sure, based on the incidents that happened 3 weeks ago,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: that it may reignite or resume at any given time.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: One side had attacked the other.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And to retaliate, once again, we saw attacks in the Gulf states.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: While we are so thankful to the Gulf states' host governments, countries,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: for literally, through their defense systems, defending, protecting our workers, our people,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: again, on the Philippine side, we must also be ready.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: More than any other origin country, migrant worker origin country, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: tayo po ang nag-respond for our citizens.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And we want to keep it that way.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We do not want to lose this opportunity to help our Filipinos in crisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So basically, di pa natitigil ang krisis in the Middle East.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And I have to add that we must also prepare for a possible Taiwan-Strait conflict

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The government already has contingency planning,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: but Congress must know whether the plan is fully costed and funded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, there is also a risk of stricter or reciprocal immigration enforcement

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: arising from our tensions with China.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: More than 100 Filipinos recently, based on reports po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ang 100 Filipinos faced immigration action in China

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: following the controversy over the Chinese nationals detained dito po sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, we cannot conclusively call this retaliation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: but we cannot ignore the possibility of,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Hong Kong has a separate immigration system,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: but it is strictly enforcing its prohibition against unauthorized second or part-time jobs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Filipino workers have been arrested or jailed for illegal employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Marami po kasi kami nakausap sa Hong Kong eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Tapos ang sinasabi po nila, karamihan sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Noon, pinapayagan sila ng Hong Kong, pero ngayon, parang ang nangyayari,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: mahigpit tayo sa mga Chinese workers dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, whatever our position, our government position maintained towards China is,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: we must also fund the protection of OFWs who may bear the consequences.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I ask the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: how many Filipinos in China and Hong Kong presently have visa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: are overstaying, or are unauthorized secondary, have secondary work problems?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what would be the minimum ERF and WASP funding na kailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: for lawyers, detention visits, documentation, medical assistance, and repatriation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And Madam Chair, what is the DMW's fully-costed evacuation plan for Filipinos in Taiwan

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: if commercial air and sea routes are disrupted?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What minimum standby ERF is required so that the government can act immediately

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: instead of waiting for a supplemental release

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: after a crisis has already begun?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we do have the figures of OFWs in both Hong Kong and China.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, we do not have figures as to who are overstaying,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: nor those who have secondary lines of work.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: There would be difficulty gathering this data.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But rest assured, over the weekend,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: we just had an Undersecretary visit Hong Kong

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: and meet with the Filipino community there

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: to assure the community of our support.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And thus far, at this stage, Mr. Congressman,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: we do not see any distress calls that are unusual in Hong Kong at this stage.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Of course, there are OFWs who need to be helped.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We have our Migrant Resource Center ready always

DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: As to how much will be needed,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac

segments.text: And nakakasama po ng loob na nakikita po natin na ultimo po yung sweldo po ng ating mga JOs po dyan po sa OWWA ay hindi pa po tama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Tama ba na 888 pa kayo, diba? Nakakahiya naman po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: And nabisita ko po ang kanilang tanggapan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Nakita ko po ang kagamitan po nila doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Paano ka po makakasagot po sa mga iyak ng mga kababayan natin kung ang kagamitan po nila ay 19 kopong-kopong pa po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Yung iba po doon napakaluma na para makapagsilbi lang po sa taong bayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: ang mga empleyado po o mga JO po natin na sumasagot po sa call center po ng OWWA ay gamit po nila ang kanilang personal na kagamitan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Hindi lang yun, madami na rin po kailangan pagawa din sa kanilang building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Balita ko po may water feature na po kayo doon na waterfall sa loob po ng inyong building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: So yun po, isa po sa mga kailangan po natin talaga is dagdagan po at bigyan po ng natamang supporta ang Department of Migrant Workers at ang OWWA

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: dahil yun nga po kailangan po natin pangalagaan ang ating OFWs tulad po ng sabi po ni

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Congressman Nazal, kanina na malaki po ang ambag ng ating mga kababayang OFWs

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: and dapat naman po talaga we need to go the extra mile for these kababayans

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: who travel across the world para mabigyan po ng kabuhayan ang kanilang mga pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bryan B. Revilla
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Chair, yun lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Thank you so much, Honorable Bryan Revilla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Now, from the majority, we recognize Honorable Ditse Tina Pancho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Mr. Chair, nakita po natin dito na we have hospitals for OFW patients.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, like in our case po, in Bulacan, we have OFWs po na pag-uwi, may mga sakit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, may we know kung ano na po mga hospital na makaka-avail po yung ating mga pasyente?

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Kasi with DOH, they have list ng government hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, do you have the same list with the DOH?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes po, Madam Chair, Madam Congresswoman.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Two things po. Una is we have an OFW hospital in San Fernando, Pampanga.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At marami po sa kanila doon ay mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Mr. Chair, is that JBL or another?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It's another hospital po. It's maybe a few kilometer, less than one kilometer away from JBL.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And marami po mga Bulacan OFWs na idadala, nakikinabang din po dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: The same with DOH, may MOA po sa inyo?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Or they have to go there directly, tapos...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, they can go there directly, ma'am, through our regional office or directly walk in sa hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron pong urgent care facility for those needing

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Basta may ID lang sila na they work for...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Basta current or former OFW, hindi na nga ho namin tinitignan, ma'am, gano'ng katagal naging OFW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kahit 2003 lang, halimbawa, tinatanggap po namin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then, ang dependents po nila, puwede rin po.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: By dependents, we mean immediate ascendants, so parents, and then immediate descendants, mga anak.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Ano po yung hospital bill nila, fully paid lahat o...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: By way of example, we have had around 100 childbirths.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Mga OFWs po ito na nanganak sa ospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Wala silang sinasagot kahit isang kusing.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then, of course, may outpatient facility, blood work.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then, ang realidad lang po, we are level 2 hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So hindi pa ho ganap ang

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, meron pa rin kaming referrals to JBL and other hospitals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, sa JBL pa rin po yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Kasi pag sa JBL, usually, JBL na po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: They won't transfer to other hospitals.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kapag major na po at wala po doon sa services that we provide,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ang surgery, for instance, then we refer accordingly to JBL.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, ang facilities, hindi pa po kumpleto?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: To the extent that it is a level 2 hospital, kumpleto po, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero hindi nga po talaga pa level 3.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ma'am, can I ask USEC Nikki to also help me respond to the query?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: USEC Nikki is the USEC in charge of the hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: With the permission of the Secretary po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Yung nabanggit po kanina ni Secretary Hans,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: papaano pumupunta ang mga OFWs sa OFW hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: May mga cases po na tinatawag lang.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then the patient do not have the capacity like pamasahe or hindi makalakad.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So, pinapasundo po namin yan ng ambulance po namin.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Either from Pampanga po, manggagaling yung ambulance.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: O meron din po kami dito sa OWWA at saka po sa DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So, iahatid po yung patient sa OFW hospital, urgent care, sa emergency room po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then, i-assess po yan ng doctor.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So, may cases po na talagang they have to...

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: stay at the hospital for complete medical checks po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then, after assessment, kung okay na po siya, ma'am,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: ibabalik din po namin siya sa bahay nila.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then, there's follow-through by phone po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: In terms po of the services, as mentioned po by the Secretary,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: while it's not level 3 yet, may mga cases po na halimbawa,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: patient ng OFW hospital, i-refer namin sa JBL.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: But in the same manner, dahil we know,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: the cases also sa JBL na medyo, ano na rin po, punong-puno.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So, pagka po may mga cases na kaya for level 2,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: si JBL po, dadalhin naman po sa OFW hospital yung pasyente.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And zero billing, yes, because we're also supported by PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And yung pondo po mismo ng hospital, yung MOOE po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Ma'am, with all the services that you give,

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: to the OFWs, nakapagtataka, bakit binabawasan pa kayo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: Di ba? Kasi nakakaawa naman po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: kasi yung puro sacrifices na po on the part of the OFWs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: pero hindi nabibigyan ng magandang budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: So, sana po mapakinggan tayo ng DBM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
segments.text: para may pagpatuloy po natin yung support natin to our kababayans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Agustina Dominique "Ditse Tina" C. Pancho
Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Thank you so much, Honorable Tina Pancho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad
segments.text: Now, we recognize from the majority, Honorable Johanne Bautista.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Good afternoon po to the Honorable Committee,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Sec. Hans, Admin PY, the DMW, and the OWWA families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Habang pasan po na ating mga OFW ang paglilingkod at pagsaservisyo sa mundo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: sino po ang nag-aalaga sa kanila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Ito po ang mahalagang papel ng DMW at ng OWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: The DMW's mandate is to ensure that policy becomes protection

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: and that protection becomes tangible relief on the ground.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Pinatunayan po ito ng DMW at ng OWA, lalo na po noong mga nakaraang buwan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Sa gitna po ng digmaan at panganib na riyan po ang DMW at ang OWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Hindi po madali ang inyong gawain, and yet you persist with quiet courage and resolve.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At patunay po kayo na ang serbisyo publiko,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: ay may puso mapagkalinga at matapang na paninindigan

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: pagdating po sa pagtatanggol ng karapatan at kapakanan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa inyong serbisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Now, I will be touching on the, I think, yung mga pinaka-importante po

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: at mga paborito ko pong programa ng DMW at ng OWWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Specifically po sa Action Fund na lagi pong in action.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: We have seen Action Fund in action in many ways, in many times.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At personally, nakita ko po talaga yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Gusto lang po natin bigyan emphasis on record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Ilan po ba ang naging benepisyaryo so far ng Action Fund for 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And maybe po, Madam Chair, the department can share with us kung ano po ang kanilang magiging pondo so far for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And sa tingin po ba nila, ay sapat nila ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At kung hindi, let's make it of record, ilan po ba ang kailangan po ng DMW to service?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: All our Filipino OFWs abroad, hindi lamang po yung nasa gitna po ng Middle East crisis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: kundi pati po yung mga nabibiktima na ating mga, yung mga scam hubs, nasa Asia po yan so far.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Ang dami rin po nating kailangan serbisyohan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Maybe we can start po with the Action Fund, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, thank you, Madam Chair. Thank you, our dear budget sponsor last year.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And congratulations po on your chairship

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: of the Committee on Social Services as we welcome our new budget sponsor, Madam Chair, Vice Chair.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Doon po sa Action Fund, as you know, it's a legal, medical, and financial assistance fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron po tayong 80,000, as I mentioned, financially assisted, 14,000 OFWs with pending or past legal cases

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: handled by our law firms and in-house lawyers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And then meron din tayong around 5,000 medical cases na natulungan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: As I said, hindi po natin tinutulungan pagka-covered upon ng insurance at nababayaran ng insurance yung medical coverage nila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Having said this, with your permission, Madam Chair, can I ask Undersecretary Felicitas Bay, who handles the Action Fund, on the details of the budget?

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Magandang araw po, Madam Chair, and also to...

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: For the Action Fund po, nabanggit na po kanina ni Secretary, doon sa aming financial assistance, only for the period January to July of 2026.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: This includes po our data for our migrant workers offices, our regional offices, and also the central office.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Sa financial assistance po ay umabot na po tayo sa mga nabigyan natin at natulungan.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Kasama din po yung ating assistance in welfare cases, 89,891.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Just for the period of January to July 2026,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: and assistance that we have provided, sourced from the Action Fund, 145,448 po yung ating beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: If ang Action Fund po ay nasimula namin ng 2023, and from July 2023 up to July of 2026,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: the total assistance and beneficiaries, umabot na po tayo sa 606,921.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: I wish also, Ma'am, to emphasize,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: we also have our legal retainers because of the ongoing legal pending and cases we have in our various posts.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: These are the law firms in the respective jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: And we have our in-house counsels, labing tatlo po yan.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: The lawyers who are employed and who are engaged right at our migrant workers' offices.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: So, yun po yung ating mga tinutulungan.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Ganon din po, nabanggit kanina yung medical retainer.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: We have existing special medical arrangements in Abu Dhabi, Jordan, in Qatar,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: and we have a medical retainer in Dubai.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: So, we wish to have more, the engagement of more medical retainers

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: para po sa ating mga kababayan na nagkakasakit.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Doon po sa medical, halos karamihan po sa ating mga kaso sa Middle East and in Asia Pacific,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: yun pong medical na nagkulang sa insurance or the insurance is not sufficient or cannot be covered.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: And at the same time, sa Middle East po,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: huroob cases or the undocumented Filipino OFWs,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: which is covered by the Action Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: As the Honorable Chair and Representative Bautista would know,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: ang Action Fund po ay covering documented and undocumented OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: So, we cater to all our OFWs and we don't discriminate.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: So, kung magkano po ba ang Action Fund currently doon po sa NEP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And if based on your assessment, sapat na po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And kung kailangan po, sa tingin niyo po ay hindi sapat, magkano pa po ba ang kulang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Sa tingin niyo, maybe we can justify ngayon po and make it of record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Ma'am, sa NEP po ay 2 billion yung sa ating Action Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: At kung kami po ay hihiling, at ito po ay additional 1 billion po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: So, can we explain bakit po natin nire-request yung additional 1 billion fund?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I believe last year po, 2 billion po ang naibigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Nakita po natin malinaw, kulang na kulang po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: But at the rate that you've seen when we have to respond into emergency crisis such as that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: maybe meron po tayong justification bakit po 1 billion ang additional na hinihiling po natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Yes, ma'am, the NEP is for 2 billion and ang kahilingan po ng ating Departamento ay an additional of 1 billion

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: to cover welfare assistance, financial, medical, repatriation, and our legal assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Gusto din po namin sanang matapatan or if it can be equivalent or corresponding to what the President has given,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: Which is to answer and to help us manage with the ongoing geopolitical crisis,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: which also not covers only the land base because we also have a lot of seafaring concerns affecting our sea-based workers

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay
segments.text: and other concerns affecting our Filipino workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Yes, ma'am. Thank you, ma'am. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And I would like to manifest my support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: For the requested increase of the DMW for the 1 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And we know na ito pong Action Fund is always in action and always needs the resources they need.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Na riyan po, mararamdaman po agad ng ating mga kababayan na malayo po sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Now, in relation to that, meron din po parang ganitong pondo ang OWA, ang ERF,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: na nalulungkot po tayong marinig, na nabawasan po, nabalitaan po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And maybe the OWA Administrator can confirm, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: na nabawasan po ang kanilang ERF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And maybe the OWA can explain ano po ba ang acceptable level of funding for our ERF

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: and yung mga beneficiaries po natin, ang services natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: and ano po sa tingin po nila ang acceptable level of the ERF funding, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, of course, our dear former budget sponsor, maraming maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Yung adbokasiya niyo po talaga para sa ating mga OFWs tuloy-tuloy po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At for the record po, nagpapasalamat po kami talaga kay Congresswoman Bautista.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Talaga po nag-immerse siya doon sa operations ng parehong DEMW at OWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At kitang-kita po doon sa kanyang komento, pareho po sila ni Kong Bryan Revilla

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: sa lahat po ng aming mga iba't ibang programa.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At nakita pa nga ni Kong Revilla, hindi niya makalimutan siguro,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: yung lumang-lumang mga computer na ngayon po dahan-dahan at napapalitan na po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: nasabi ko na po, tatlong taon na nasa 1.2 billion po ang level po nito.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngayon po sa NEP natin, nasa 900 million na lamang po.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kahit na nasa kaligitnaan pa rin tayo ng isang geopolitical crisis.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Itong taon lang po itong mismo, 1.6 billion na po ang nagastos ng OWA sa repatriation-related expenses.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, isa pong numero na bago kong sasabihin, to put on record, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: the Emergency Repatriation Fund has served already 139,688 OFW clients.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: As of July 31 of this year.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At the rate we're going, Madam Chair, we will finish as forecasted, around 240 to 250,000 clients.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: And we are thankful to the President, and of course, the support of Congress as well,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: and the Department of Budget and Management for the additional 700 million supplemental.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, kami po ay tumatakbo na lang dun sa supplemental.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ubus na po ang continuing from last year.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At ngayon po, ay dun na po kami tumatakbo dun sa dagdag na pondo.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ang malaki yung concern namin dito, ay isa pa lang po yung crisis.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dun sa regional crisis na yun, ay nakita po natin na ang pondo ng DMW at OWA ay pwedeng sa loob ng tatlo hanggang anim na buwan maubos agad.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, depende sa kung gaano kadami ang apektado pong OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, gusto po namin maging handa.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Handa para magbigay ng serbisyo kung ano man pong kaguluhan ang mangyari.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa aming pong pananaw, ang hinihiling po namin, Madam Chair, at the minimum, ma-restore at 1.2.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ngunit, ang hinihingi po namin, base dun sa aming sulat na ipinadala po sa ating mahal na speaker,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Para po, kami po ay nasa a little bit below the 1.5 billion mark.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Napaka-importante po na parehong action fund at ERF ang may pondo.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kasi meron pong mga gastos na hindi po pwedeng bayaran ng ERF.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At meron pong mga gastos na pang action fund po talaga siya.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, meron po kaming complimentary po yan para whole package po ang serbisyo namin para sa OFWs, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, ang hiling po namin is an additional 575 million po para po sa emergency repatriation fund po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And in relation to that, I also manifest my strong support for the return of at least the minimum of 1.2 billion ng ERF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At kung maaari pa po ay the few hundred million na nire-request po ng OWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Dahil nakikita naman po natin, diretsyo naman po sa tao ang pinupuntahan ng mga pondong yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At pagka po yan ay nababawasan kasi meron pa rin pong mga lugar na kailangan pa rin pong pagserbisyohan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Baka po mawalan sila ng allocation for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Now, lastly na lang po, given the limited time, andami po, na-mention po yung immersion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Lahat po yan, yung mga shelter, yung mga serbisyo ng ano,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Nakita po natin lahat yan, totoo po talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: That's why I express my very strong support for the increase for the funds of Action Fund and the ERF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Now, pagka po tayo ay nagre-rescue, nagre-repatriate, hindi po natatapos doon ang serbisyon ng DMW at ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Napaka-importante po, lalo na po sa amin, ang reintegration program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I think na-touch up pa na po yan kanina, but we also just want to check on the funding of the reintegration program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Hindi po kasi po pwede na uuwi lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Sila dito, gusto po natin, sila ay panatag pa rin pagbalik nila dito, whether babalik sila abroad or mapapanatili na dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Ano po ba ang mga serbisyo nito? Magkano po ang pondo? Sapat po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: At kung hindi po ay maybe we can make it of record na rin po, and we can justify it po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: With your permission, Madam Chair, I will start things off.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But we have our Assistant Secretary for Reintegration here who can supply the details.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But essentially, ang framework po natin, kalinga, kaalaman, kabuhayan, at kaagapay.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, yung kalinga is yung psychosocial welfare side sa mga nanunumbalik.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: As I mentioned, when you speak of the U.S.-Israel-Iran war,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: mismo si Presidente, nung sumalubong sa mga nanumbalik,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: nagtanong at may mga nagkwento, iba pa nga sa kanila, mga bata,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: na nakadinig ng pagyanig ng lupa, ng bahay,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: kapag merong falling debris ng projectiles or missile attacks na nainkwentro sila sa host country,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And since that time, around 6,000 had been provided this particular welfare assistance,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: psychosocial counseling, and other welfare interventions.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung kaalaman is yung skills training interventions with DG Kiko Benitez.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, mga also, nearly around 5,000 naman po nabigyan ng serbisyo along these lines.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung mga nanumbalik para mag-retool, mag-retrain.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Halimbawa, domestic worker who were 30% of those who returned,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: binigyan ng bagong panimula by way of a barista training sa TESDA.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Para siya naman ay hindi lamang domestic worker, kundi maging barista sa isang coffee shop or restaurant.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, meron pong ganitong efforts, 5,000 ay nabiyayaan along these lines.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: In the first semester, mga higit kumulang 2,000 ang nakapag-avail ng capital assistance,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: not just from DMW OWA, but other agencies such as DTI, DOT, and DA Agriculture.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Merong kaagapay, kasi ang ibig sabihin naman ng kaagapay, so 4Ks po ito, no?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung pang-apat na K is kaagapay, kasi si Pangulong Marcos, bago pa nangyari itong sigalot,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: binuklod na kaming lahat na government agencies.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya nakita na po ni Presidente na hindi lamang DMW-OWWA, but obviously other government agencies

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: should provide the necessary assistance by way of re-employment, livelihood, or retooling or reskilling.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For the details dun sa budget, the good news is for the first time during your time in the President's term

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, naging nine figures in the 100 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, maniwala po kayo't hindi, below 100 million lang dati ang MOOE ng National Reintegration Center.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At hindi lamang po tumuntong ng nine figures, kundi 300 million na po ang incoming budget sa NEP

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ng MOOE ng National Reintegration Center.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, humihingi pa po kami ng additional 300 para tuluyan maging ganap.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi yung binabanggit po kanina, pangangailangan,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: sa crisis, also includes, para sa mga nasa abroad, also includes crisis interventions sa kanilang panumbalik.
