segments.text: sa iba't-ibang mga Kongreso at Parlamento para matugunan agad ang issue na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kasaman po ang boses ng mga kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para itulak ang pagdadagdag ng pondo para dun sa nakaranas ng malalaking kaltas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil Madam Chair, hindi po makatarungan na sa panahon pa ng patong-patong na krisis

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ay mababawasan pa ang pondo ng ating mga frontliners na tumutulong sa ating mga distressed OFWs

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at mga nangangailangan na Pilipino sa ibang bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, Madam Chair, nabanggit niyo kanina na kailangan niyo sana ng dagdag na suporta

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa mga retainers sa medical field, para sa AKSYON Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon po ba meron na kayong mga existing na mga personnel para rito?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, meron tayong medical assistance provided by retainers in selected posts.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: What we have are partnerships with medical institutions like hospitals in the host countries.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, yung formal partnership, the way we have a legal retainership with law firms,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ito yung binabanggit ni Admin PY kanina, yun yung kailangan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But right now, the standout post here would be Dubai.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Our Dubai post with around 700,000 Filipino workers would have a partnership with a particular clinic.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: medical institution that provides such medical services.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero yun nga po, admittedly, kaya tamang-tama yung binabanggit ni Admin PY kanina,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: na kailangan pang palaganapin itong medical retainership similar to our legal retainership agreements

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: para hayag at sigurado ang matatakbuhan ng ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: With the permission of the Secretary,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: equally important, if not more important, is the health, medical retainership.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Itinutulak po natin din, Madam Chair, napaka-importante po dahil nakikita din namin

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ang tumataas din pong mga kaso nang meron pong mental health conditions among our dear OFWs.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ng ating mga welfare officers abroad ay importante at kailangan sa ibang post po,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: dahil nga alam namin po limitado,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: ang retainership din po ng mga psychologists or psychiatrists.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po, sa araw-araw po natin pag-uusap sa ating mga distress workers,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: marami po sa kanila ang kailangan, hindi lamang po ng consultation, pati po yung medication.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, meron na pong efforts ang DMW at OWA patungkol sa, for example,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: as said by our Secretary, partnerships. Meron din po tayong telemedicine efforts.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pero sa pananaw po natin, wala pa rin tatalo sa person-to-person po, di ba po, na konsultasyon

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: para po sa mga professionals na licensed po sa iba't-ibang mga bansa.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Para po ma-take advantage po natin.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: array of services, medical services para sa ating pong mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, magkano po yung proposed funding para sa serbisyong ito ng DMW ng OWA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nais po natin malaman kasi syempre, ang laking tulong po ng mga partnerships natin sa mga CSOs, NGOs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: iba pang private partners, pero nangangailangan pa rin pala, nangangailangan pa din ng dagdag na pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na, Madam Chair, ang nangangailangan ng mga stress debriefing efforts and services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang naman po yung ating mga distressed OFWs, maski po mismo yung mga manggagawa natin sa DMW, sa OWA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lahat po ng mga frontliners na tumutulong, maski po sila, nangangailangan din ng mga critical incident stress debriefing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil hindi po biro ang hinaharap po nila na pagpoproseso ng iba't ibang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kaso, marami po dito matinding abuso na nararanasan ng ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi yan po ang nakita natin, no, na habang tumutulong po tayo sa iba, nakakaligtaan po natin yung tulong din po para doon sa mga frontliners natin na humaharap sa ganitong tipo ng mga situations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: On the part of OWA po, Madam Chair, kasi meron din po, of course, under the action fund sa DMW,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: magkatuwang naman po kami na frontliners.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Meron po kaming tinatawag na very high priority pagdating po sa medical retainership po naming proposal.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ay sa mga following posts.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Sa Abu Dhabi at sa Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa high priority,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Of course, Madam Chair, we will work within the budget that will be given to us.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Humihingi po kami on the part of OWA ng additional po na nasa 130 million.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ay susuporta sa medical and health retainer.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: And kasama na po, Madam Chair, ang additional legal retainer.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dahil dumadami rin po talaga ang kailangan ng tulong legal.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Meron pong mga criminal cases, civil cases or commercial cases.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kung saan tumutulong po kami ng DMW, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: On the part of DMW, Madam Chair, I will pass the mic out to them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron din bang pondo para halimbawa po mga gender sensitivity training

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa mga gender sensitive, trauma-informed and victim-centered na approach

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa pag-i-interview, processing ng iba't ibang tipo ng kaso?

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Numero uno po yan, Madam Chair, dahil po yan ang mandato ng OWA.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Nakatutok po kami sa paggawa ng gender responsive program.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Dito po sa mga distress situation, napaka-importante yung gender sensitivity, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: And you have my commitment as the administrator na lagi po nating itataas ang antas ng serbisyo

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: at nakatutok talaga doon sa pagiging, sa pagpakita ng empathy, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Pag-crisis na, talagang very highly emotional po ang ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: So, patuloy po ang, tuloy-tuloy po ang training, retraining.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: At saka, Madam Chair, on your point earlier, importante rin po sa amin yung care for the frontliners.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kasi ho, pag sobrang puyatin po or kaya po 24-7 na nagsiservisyo, lalo na pag may crisis,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kaya marami rin po kaming mga capacity building, mga programa para dito po sa ating mga personnel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May pinakahuling bilang po ba kayo ng mga kaso ng abuso na lumapit po sa inyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ilan po dito may percentage po ba kayo nung may kinalaman rin sa gender-based violence?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa amin kasi, Madam Chair, nabanggit ko na rin naman po ito sa DMW tsaka sa OWA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming po talaga nagpapatulong ng mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: tayong OFWs pagdating sa ganitong mga kaso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At marami po kasi sa kanila dahil nga mahirap na pong habulin yung mga perpetrators ng violence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Talagang ang sinasalalayan na lang na tulong ay yung availability ng psychosocial support at yung mga reintegration programs na meron tayo.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, meron po tayong numero, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Ito po ay nakakategorize sa klase ng welfare case.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Madam Chair, patungkol po sa sexual abuse or harassment, ma'am, from January to June 2026 po, ang reported po at na tulungan ng OWA ay nasa 1,800 po across the buong mundo na po ito.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: From Asia Pacific, Middle East, and Europe and Americas.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Kung ikukumpara po ito sa numero ng January to December 2025 po,

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: masasabi po natin na nasa 2,600 po ang kaso po ng ganitong klase ng abuse at violence na hinarap po ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, mahingi po tayo ng kasalukuyan na ginagawa nilang referral system, pakikipagtulungan sa iba't ibang agencies tulad ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano po yung chain of custody kung merong urgent na kaso at marami pa pong ibang tulong na available?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, Madam Chair, gusto ko naman pong magtanong tungkol sa collection ng verification fee para sa mga contracts at labor-related documents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Saan po ba napupunta yung mga kinukolekta nating verification fees? At magkano ang nakolekta?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, with your permission, I will ask Usec. Niki to respond.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But let me respond first to the matter on gender sensitivity training.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Rest assured, Madam Congresswoman, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: wala po tayong personel na umaalis na hindi nakakadaan sa gender sensitivity, gender responsiveness training.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: As we always like to say, a substantial number, more than a vast majority of our workers assisted are female workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And not just female workers, but those who also belong in the LGBTQ plus sector.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya dito rin po ang napakahalaga ng gender responsiveness on our part.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And we do not tolerate any form of mishandling of any case along these lines, sa gender insensitivity ng ating personnel.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At kaduktong din po dito yung aspeto ng medical retainership at yung binabanggit ni Admin PY na mental health issues.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi, when we are in the hands of expert

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: medical care, such as a medical retainer,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: then we are assured na ang handling ng kaso, let's say physical or emotional abuse,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ng isang female worker or LGBTQ plus worker is well handled or managed kapag medical expert ang nagahandle.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya mahalaga po yung binabanggit na medical retainership because we want the medical expertise of a person,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: of a health worker, to take care of these types of cases.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Now, dun po sa verification fee, yes, it is under the DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For every contract verified, there is a US$10 fee.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: This is under the auspices of the DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It is a collected fee that partially reverts back to our operations.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And I will ask Usec. Niki

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, with the permission of the Chair,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Usec. Niki can take up the matter on the verification fees.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair, and with the permission of the Secretary po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Ang current po natin ngayon for verification fee from fiscal year 2023 to 2026 present, meaning January to July po, it's around 5,851,298,096.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And these are deposited in the Bureau of Treasury po. And from that amount po, meron po tayong in-earmarked under our GAA.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So for 2024 po, we earmarked around 163 million. And then in 2025, that's 580 million. And for 2026, another 580 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: But under the 2027 NEP po, around 700 million po, 777 to be exact ang in-earmarked po under the 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, meron pang more than 2 billion pesos na nasa Treasury na hindi pa po earmarked for particular purposes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon Madam Chair, kasi meron din po tayong mga reports ng increases sa verification fees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano po yung mga factors kung bakit kailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pong magtaas nitong mga verification fees?

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: From what we've known, Your Honor, we have not increased the verification fee. It's pegged at 10 US dollars as mentioned by the Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Alright. Kung maaari niyo pong magbibigay po ako sa inyo ng ulat tungkol po sa mga nakuha namin na reports ng increase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa po sa Hong Kong, sa Singapore, meron pong reports ng increases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pwede pong ma-review na lang po ito ng DMW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, atungkol naman Madam Chair sa cut sa budget ng Maritime Research and Skills Competency Program na nakapasok ang Maritime Training and Maritime Assessment Service,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: paano po maapekto ka ng budget cut na ito ang existing services natin para sa international seafarers?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We have the Executive Director of the National Maritime Polytechnic here, but let me start it off as well.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We have made significant strides sa 19th and 20th Congresses sa budget ng NMP. So we're very thankful.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dahil dito, nagkaroon ng early phase 1 ng infrastructure improvements for the first time in 50 years.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Started during Marcos Sr.'s administration and finally resumed under Marcos Jr.'s administration na improve ang facilities sa National Maritime Polytechnic.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: For the first time, meron mga certain training programs that have been rendered free to our seafarers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Hindi lang discounted or subsidized, completely free na certain programs and our Executive Director will provide the details on this.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So without further ado, Madam Chair, Madam Congresswoman, may request ED Victor Rosario to explain yung budget adjustments effect ng NEP sa NMP.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honors, with the permission of the Good Secretary, first of all, we would like to express our profound gratitude to Congress because it is only in this year that we received the highest budgetary allocation for the National Maritime Polytechnic since our inception in 1978.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: We have received 406 million for this year and 271 million of which will...

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Fund the implementation of our modernization plan at NMP Tacloban, basically to improve our infrastructure for our training facilities.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: This October, we will be groundbreaking our 200 million dormitory with the President and the Secretary.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: We will also be constructing a new training pool of 32 million, another new firefighting area and many other infrastructure program.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And to answer the question of the Good Congresswoman Elago as to the decrease of the budget of NMP, primarily it's because of the reduced capital outlay.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Kasi napagbigyan na po tayo ng DBM ng 271 million for this year.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Now for next year, binigyan po tayo ng 53 million, 50 million of which will go to the construction of another training building.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Sapagkat kailangan po talaga natin, Congresswoman, yung...

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Nang karagdagang training classroom sapagkat, as we speak, mayroon po tayong 40-year-old main training building sa NMP na ginawa pa ng mga Japanese, ng JICA.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Nine rooms are used for simulator and our laboratory rooms where we store and house our simulator.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And with the approval of the Good Secretary for our free training program, we expect more enrollment next year.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: That is why kailangan po talaga natin ng mga karagdagang classrooms.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Pero yung napagbigyan po sa DBM is only 50 million of the 125 million that we proposed that will enable us sana to construct additional 15 classrooms.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Isa lang po yung wish list ng NMP na sana ma-restore yung 76 million na kakulangan para makonstruct natin yung bagong training building.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Kasi nga po, dun sa free training program na in-approve po ni Secretary pursuant to DMW Memorandum Order 360,

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: simula po nung August 3, lahat po ng regular training program ng NMP ay libre na po.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And as a matter of fact, marami pong trainees na nanggagaling pa sa Zamboanga, pumupunta sa Tacloban.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: It's a long story bakit yung NMP ay nasa Tacloban, but to cut it short, it's because of the former First Lady Imelda Romaldes Marcos.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: That is why it's situated at the foot of San Juanico.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario

NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And as of August 3, we have already trained 3,026 seafarers that availed our free training program.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And we are expecting, with the support of Secretary Cacdac, we've been given additional funding for our honoraria.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: We will be training maximum of 12,000 seafarers by the end of December.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Mr. Congressman, to answer your question, we are also exerting effort for our expansion plan.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: As a matter of fact, Congressman Revilla, your mother, attended our presentation of our feasibility study for the establishment of a regional training center in Tanza, Cavite.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: Yes, kasi may lupa po yung NMP doon sa Cavite.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: And another feasibility study, Mr. Congressman, Madam Chair, we will conduct it this year with the Development Academy of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: We will also be constructing, establishing an RTC in Davao City, and thereafter, CDO.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: We will also take into consideration Cagayan de Oro City, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: That would be all, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: NMP Executive Director III Victor A. Del Rosario
segments.text: I hope I was able to satisfy the question of the good Congresswoman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nagalala rin po tayo, hindi lang doon sa mga pangangailangan sa bagong infrastruktura, para sa mas maraming training centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero yung pambayad po natin sa mga personnel, syempre marami po dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi naman po dapat lang na honorarya, pero kung maaari, meron din tayong mga personnel na regular, may security of tenure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at talagang mapagkakatiwalaan natin sa iba't ibang mga pangangailangan na may kinalaman sa maritime training and maritime assessment services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Madam Chair, panghuli na lang po ng mga katanungan tungkol po sa mga services para sa ating seafarers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bago ho ako magsimula sa mga katanungan na ito, meron na po bang update tungkol po doon sa ating search operations sa nawawala po na seafarer natin, si Sir George Miranda,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na napabalita kung nawawalaan itong March 2026 dahil po sa pag-atake sa kanilang tugboat sa Strait of Hormuz.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, unfortunately, wala pa po tayong kaukulang update.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It's a function of kung saan po nangyari yung attack.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It's in the Strait of Hormuz, kaya admittedly may kahirapan po sa pag-salvage nung tugboat kung saan siya naroon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So we still are hoping na kahit pa pano, darating ang panahon na magkaroon din ng...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: salvaging ng tugboat kapag ligtas na ang sitwasyon sa Strait of Hormuz.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang sinasagawa po natin, I had personally met with Mrs. Miranda,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: at ang sinasagawa po natin ngayon is tinutulungan natin ng pamilya ng filing ng legal claims.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi po, meron na pong discussion with the ship owner in Dubai.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya meron na po tayong abogadong

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: naatasan with the acceptance of Mrs. Miranda, kung saan yung lawyer po natin na nakikipag-usap ngayon sa ship owner doon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya ongoing po ito, Madam Congresswoman, and rest assured, I personally have been in contact with Mrs. Miranda.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Naka-WhatsApp exchange ko lang po siya nung nakaraang araw.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At hindi po natin ito bibitawan until magkaroon ng conclusion itong legal claims ng pamilya sa shipowner.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero aaminin ko po, sa ngayon po ay hindi po talaga na-recover yung human remains ni Oiler Miranda.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya patuloy pa rin tayong nag-umaasa na darating ang panahon na masasalvage kahit pa pano yung tugboat na kinalalagyan niya doon sa Strait of Hormuz.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, there is a document po here and I think we can provide...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: you a copy of a note verbal along these lines, but for the sanctity of the grief that Mrs. Miranda is going through,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: we will just furnish you a copy of this document from the Omani government, Madam Congresswoman.

Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At hindi po tayo nawawala ng pag-asa.

segments.text: Habang meron po tayong mga na-rescue, meron din po isang namatay dahil nga sa kalagayan sa Strait of Hormuz.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago

segments.text: Before I would move for the approval of the increase of 2 billion each, I would like to just state I have here a constituent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The problem in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, there is the non-issuance of resident permit, ICAMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Could you explain this one first?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What is this ICAMA not issued by the government of the Kingdom?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Who should be able to have our residents there work and transact business?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yes, in general po, this is required for every OFW who goes there.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So every OFW has what you call an ICAMA, residence permit.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, it can happen na nagkakaroon ng legal problems.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang mga kababayan natin, most likely related sa kanilang stay, maaring nag-overstay, o di kaya perceived violations of their stay.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, ang key po dito, in brief, Mr. Chair, is the legal assistance through the AKSYON Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, the good news is kami ni Usec. Jun Rasul just came from Jeddah and we met our lawyers in Saudi.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: The Tebiah Law Office who provides legal assistance, they have an array of 30 lawyers in their law firm who provide assistance to our workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, we easily refer these cases na hindi maka-renew ng ICAMA for immigration-related problems or labor-related problems one way or another.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, rest assured that we address this situation.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Some cases take longer than others, admittedly.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But rest assured, Mr. Congressman, Madam Chair, we are on top of the legal cases that are being handled by our law firm, our legal retainers, our in-house lawyers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And also, kung merong utang po, halimbawa, sa ospital or immigration-related penalties, we shoulder these expenses for our workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez

segments.text: Next to interpellate from the majority, we have Representative Florabel Yatco.

segments.text: Itatanong ko lang naman yung tulad nung nabanggit kanina ni Congressman Tina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Like during 25-26, ilang pamilya at OFW ang nasilbihan natin dito sa hospital na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: 2027 na budget natin, ano po ang mga kongkretong improvements na maaaring nilang asahan sa pagdating sa mga access services at sa quality care ng OFW?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: I will request Usec. Niki Tutay who handles the hospital to answer the details.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But at the outset, 184,870 po ang napagsilbihan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung term ng ating mahal na Pangulo, ang panahon po natin sa Department of Migrant Workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We can provide the necessary breakdowns on a year-to-year basis.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And yung kaukulang budget po na binigay sa atin is 423.59 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: However, as mentioned during the question of Congressman Rodriguez,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Can I request Usec. Niki, Madam Chair, to provide some more details?

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: 'Yun pong nabanggit po ng ating kalihim ay 'yung number of patients, unique patients po ito.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So it could be the OFW herself, either a family also, or pwede rin po yung parents po ng OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So over the years po, tumataas naman po yung ating unique patient, sir.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So we started with around 7,383 back in second half of 2022.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then it rose to 34,634 patients.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And in 2025, 59,000 or close to 60,000 po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: For 2026 po, January until July, it's close to 40,000 na po na patients. And the services po, the diagnostics and the other medical services ay pataas po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, this year, we were able to introduce the pre-employment medical exam at a lower rate compared to the other clinics or hospitals for our overseas Filipino workers before they depart.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: The other services po that we have ay yung pong cancer care, we are preparing it na.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: It's currently being constructed and we do hope po that by the first...

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then we want, we're targeting a level 3 because the bed capacity is around 102.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, we are at a level 2 with around 78 beds approved by the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: But for the number of patients, do you think, is it all coming from the central Luzon?

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Based on our statistics, Your Honor, we have around 90 to 95% coming from Luzon, particularly po from central Luzon.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: But we have patients coming from Mindanao, Visayas, and also as far as Bicol region po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Actually, sana nga magkaroon tayo, Mr. Chair, ng Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao na OFW Hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: since nabanggit niyo na nga po yung cancer care center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: can the department tell us how much is the 2027 budget specifically intended for the cancer care?

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Aside from the 200 million, kasama na ba yung 200 million doon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Enough ba siya to serve all the cancer patients, to pay the salaries of the special doctors?

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: It may not be enough, Your Honor, but for

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: 2027 NEP, our budget is around 400 million po.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So kaya nagpapadagdag po sana kami ng 200 million pa.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: We're thinking of a dialysis services also because most of the patients sa OFW Hospital po ay meron pong chronic disease,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Kidney disease, that's the top health or medical needs.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And then, yung cancer po ay tumataas din po yung cases po ng cancer na pumupunta po sa aming hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Sana ma-request niyo na yung dialysis center din, maisabay next year?

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Kasi, Mr. Chair, I've been in OFW and nag-medical mission na rin kami sa OFW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: And it's a very beautiful hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Medyo may mga kulang, kaya dapat mataasan natin yung budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: Pero maayos, na-maintain, na papatakbo ng maayos.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: She helped us po in one of the medical missions.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And we would like to pursue that on a regular basis together with the Makati Medical Center.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: We work with Makati Med for that for every year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Florabel C. Yatco
segments.text: So, sana hindi lang OFW, but yung mga...

segments.text: Magandang hapon sa ating DMW family and of course the OWWA family. Alam niyo po kanina habang nandito ako halos naitanong na lahat itong mga, lalo na sa reintegration. Mahirap talaga pag huli, halos wala ka nang maitanong eh. So naitanong po na lahat. So maganda naman yung programa ng returning OFWs natin. Naging successful naman yung binibigay tulong ng gobyerno. So meron lang akong katanungan doon, parang hindi ito naitanong. Paano po yung ating OFW na bigyan, tapos ika nga hindi nag-materialize yung binigay sa kanyang pondo? Ano po ang susunod na gagawin ng ating OWWA o ang DMW?

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sige po, kami po ni Admin PY ang sasagot sa katanungan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: It can happen nga po na binigyan ng pondong pang-negosyo, halimbawa. At it can happen na hindi nag-prosper yung negosyo, pero hindi naman po sarado ang pinto.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi ang batayan namang prinsipyo po diyan is, as long as merong determinasyon at sound business proposal yung ating OFW, naniniwala din po kasi kami na sa isang beses na pagbagsak ng isang OFW sa attempt niya, posibleng dalawang beses siya makakabangon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang kailangan pong gawin ay suportahan siya kung karapat-dapat naman pong suportahan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We will also reinforce this through business mentorship.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: May mga private sector and government partners po tayo sa DTI, halimbawa, who can provide coaching para mabigyan ng kumpiyansa at saka tulong na rin sa technical na aspeto ng pagnenegosyo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pangalawa po, kung ito ay sa larangan ng medikal o legal, hindi po natin siya bibitawan kahit anong mangyari.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kung patuloy niyang kailangan ng tulong,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: kahit hindi nag-work yung kanyang negosyo pero patuloy ang kanyang medical assistance na kinakailangan, hindi po natin siya bibitawan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya walang magiging impact yung hindi pagtagumpay sa negosyo sa pag-treat ng kanyang medical condition.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And so goes with legal. We continue to provide legal assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Hindi po magiging, hindi magdudulot ng kawalan ng pag-asa sa legal at medical na aspeto o financial na aspeto dahil nandoon pa rin tayo para gabayan siya.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And of course, as I said, Mr. Congressman, Madam Chair, Admin PY will also have her say on this matter.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Indeed, the Magna Carta for Seafarers has resolved in terms of policy, practice,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac

segments.text: With the kind permission of the Secretary, one of the greatest accomplishments of this administration,

segments.text: including this Congress, is yung the passage of the Magna Carta for Seafarers.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Bernard P. Olalia
segments.text: At tama po si Sec, meron na pong IRR niyan.
